news_items.headline: Defensive blunder dooms Yankees in 3-1 loss to Blue Jays
news_items.summary: The Yankees had a late lead with Gerrit Cole dealing, but a defensive blunder allowed a two-run inning, as New York fell to the Blue Jays, 3-1, on Friday night in Toronto.

news_items.headline: Francisco Lindor, Jared Young's home runs lift Mets to 4-1 win over Nationals
news_items.summary: The Mets had just one hit through five innings, but woke up in the sixth inning and would go on to beat the Washington Nationals, 4-1, on Friday night.
